auth_consent.evidence: Closed-Beta auth/session hardening is merged (PRs #369-#371): age >=16, email verification, onboarding/account-status gating, server-managed HttpOnly sessions, revocation and device-session management. Consent/health-data separation and withdrawal remain incompletely proven.

account_privacy.evidence: Session privacy is hardened without IP/location storage for session display; export, deletion/anonymization, consent withdrawal and full parent/child lifecycle remain open or unaccepted.

backend_runtime.evidence: Current repository builds, container runtime checks and database package tests are green; server-authoritative mission/economy foundations and global-location logic exist. This is repository/runtime-package verification, not Production confirmation.

rewards_missions.evidence: Server flow attempt -> evidence -> admin review -> completion -> internal ledger -> wallet exists with replay/idempotency/audit protections. WFXP vs WFP/XP terminology remains an owner-reviewed migration issue and token/real-money authority is not active.

cross_repo_contract.evidence: Technical contracts exist in code, while graphical/UI code and Buddy-specific Unity AR code still physically reside here pending explicit migration to their domain repositories.

rule: WellFit-now owns the technical product: web/backend, auth, data, APIs, mission/economy/server authority, security/runtime and general technical application/mobile logic. Graphics/UI/UX belong to WellFit; Buddy-specific behavior/presentation/AR belongs to WellFit-Buddy.
